## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include migration steps for breaking changes.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any relevant checks not run. Documentation-only changes do not require new unit tests.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Test improvement

## Platform Impact

- [ ] All platforms
- [ ] Documentation / tooling only
- [ ] WeChat only
- [ ] Alipay only
- [ ] Other: ___

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the existing code style (ESLint + Prettier)
- [ ] Existing tests strengthened or behavior regressions covered, where applicable
- [ ] `yarn run lint` passes
- [ ] `yarn run typecheck` passes (for code changes)
- [ ] `yarn run test` passes; coverage checked where applicable
- [ ] `yarn run build` passes (for SDK builds or cross-platform changes)
- [ ] `yarn run docs:build` passes (for website changes)
- [ ] Cross-platform compatibility considered
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
